_comment: Editor-responsiveness baseline for the Perf trace workflow (.github/workflows/perf-trace.yml). scripts/check-perf-regression.mjs takes the BEST p95 across the workflow's iterations for each scenario and fails if it is more than the threshold percent above `p95_ms` here. Update these numbers in the same commit as a deliberate perf change; this diff is what reviewers see.
_note_provenance: Seeded 2026-10-02 from three local runs (best-of-3 p95) on a ~3,000-line document, not from a CI runner. Re-baseline from the first CI run's log if the runner differs much.
_note_known_cost: These are slow on purpose-built large documents: every sync re-parses the whole document, and that parse also runs between keystrokes. Tracked in NEXT_STEPS.md (incremental re-parse). Expect a deliberate re-baseline downwards when that lands.
